tei:div.tei:p: skabs gnyis pa lam shes/

gnyis pa thob byed lam shes 'chad pa la gnyis te/ 'brel bkod pa/ mtshon byed rnams bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ chos bcus mtshon par byas pa'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen de thob pa yang lam shes la rag las pas rgyal chen rigs bzhi nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i 'khor gsar du 'dus pa na/ de dag la lam shes mtshon byed rnams gsungs pa'i don no// lam shes kyi rgyu/ gnyis pa (mtshon byed rnams bshad pa )la gnyis te/ lam shes kyi rgyu/ de las skyes pa'i lam shes so/ /dang po ni/ lha rnams rung bar bya ba'i phyir// 'od kyis mog mog por mdzad dang*// yul nges pa dang khyab pa dang*// rang bzhin dang ni de yi las// 'gal rkyen sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i nyon mongs dang bral ba na/ lam shes skye ba'i sems rten tu ston pa ni/ lha brgya byin la sogs pa rnams lam shes skye ba'i rten du rung bar bya ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das rang gi 'od kyis/ lha rnams kyi 'od mog mog por zil gyis mnan nas nga rgyal mngon gyur med par mdzad pa dang*/ mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gyi 'od kyi drung na lha de rnams kyi las kyi rnam smin las skyes pa'i 'od de rnams ni lham me ma yin/ zhes so// mthun rkyen lam shes skye ba'i yul du+u nges pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang*/ lha'i bu gang dag rdzogs byang du sems ma bskyed pa de dag gis kyang bla med rdzogs byang du sems bskyed par bya'o/ /zhes so// nyer len gyi rgyu 'gro ba thams cad la khyab par gnas pa'i rigs bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po dang ste/ 'di ni 'phags pa rnams kyi bgrod bya'i theg pa yin zhing*/ 'bras bu mthar thug kyang 'di yi dri ma ma lus sangs pa gcig nyid du nges pas so/ /gal te de dag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na de dag la ngas rjes su yi rang bar bya'o/ /zhes so// 'phel byed gzhan don sgrub pa'i ched du srid par skye ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs mi spong ba'i rang bzhin dang ni ldan pa ste/

de yang srid par 'ching byed kyi nyon mongs sems ma zhi bar byed pa'i cha sa dang po nas ngang gis spangs zin la/ 'dir bstan ni skye ba len pa'i nus can 'dod chags kyi bag nyal ched du ma spangs pa de dang*/ spang byar gyur pa'i nyon mongs can ma yin pa'i ma rig pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i ma dag sa'i skabs su yod de zag bcas kyi phung po 'grub bo/ /phyi ma ni/ dag sa gsum dang dman lam sngon du song ba'i skabs kyi sa 'og ma rnams su bzhag dgos shing zag med kyi phung po 'grub bo/ /dman pa'i lhag med myang 'das las sad nas theg chen tshogs lam du 'jug pa'i skabs kyi phung po 'grub byed kyang phyi ma 'di'o//kho bo ni de dag gi dge ba'i phyogs la bar chad mi byed do/ /zhes so// zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gol ba'i phyir du rdzogs smin sbyang gsum ma byas par yang dag mtha' mngon du mi byed par sems can rnams grol bar byed pa de'i las la brtson pa rnams so/ /khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos rnams las mchog tu khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos rnams thob par byed do/ /zhes so// nyan thos kyi lam shes tshul/ gnyis pa (de las skyes pa'i lam shes )la gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi lam shes tshul dang*/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes tshul dang*/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po (nyan thos kyi lam shes tshul )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lam gyi dbye ba/ nyan rang gi lam shes tshul lo/ /dang po( lam gyi dbye ba )la/ 1 tshogs lam ni/ so thar gyi tshul khrims la brten nas rang gi sde snod la thos bsam byed cing*/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi sgom pa'o// 2 sbyor lam ni/ bden par dmigs tshul bstan zin la yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dbang po lnga/ stobs lnga rim gyis sgom pa'o// 3 mthong lam ni/ 'dod pa'i sdug bden gyi gnas tshul rtogs pa bar chad med lam gyis bsdus pa chos bzod/

rnam grol lam gyis bsdus pa chos shes/ khams gong gi sdug bden gyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam gnyis la rjes bzod rjes shes de bzhin bden pa gzhan gsum la'ang sbyar bas sems kyi skad cig ma bcu drug las/ snga ma bco lnga mthong lam ste 'phags lam brgyad kyi rang bzhin no// 4 sgom lam ni/ sa dgur spang bya rim gyis las phye na gya gcig cig car ba yin na dgu yin la byang chub yan lag bdun gyi rang bzhin no// 5 mi slob lam ni/ srid nyon dgu pa zad pa thob cing shes pa ste ji srid 'tsho bar lhag bcas shi nas lhag med myang 'das so// gnyis pa (nyan rang gi lam shes tshul )ni/ nyan rang gi rtogs pa mtha' dag theg chen mthong lam nyid du yar ldan du rdzogs pas gang zag gzhan rgyud du rtogs pa'i lam rnams ni chos kyi spyan la sogs pas shes la rang rgyud du rtogs pa ni mnyam bzhag tu chos bdag med pa'i rnam pas mi dmigs par shes shing nyan rang gi tshul dang mthun pas sgom par ni mi byed do// gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ 'phags lam shes tshul/ de'i rgyu sbyor lam bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lam shes nyid kyi tshul la ni// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi/ rnam pa mi dmigs sgo nas ni// nyan thos lam 'di shes par bya// lam shes pa nyid kyi tshul las nyan thos kyi lam shes pa ni 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dag gi rnam pa las/ sdug bden la/ mi rtag pa dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ bdag med pa ste/ stong pa dang rang ngo zhi ba dang bzhi'o/ / kun 'byung gi bden pa la/ rgyu nad 'dra ba dang*/ kun 'byung rang ngo 'bras 'dra dang*/ rab tu skye ba zug rngu 'dra dang*/ rkyen dge ba 'joms pa'i sdig pa 'dra ba ste bzhi'o/ /sdug kun thun mong du pha rol dang*/ 'jig pa'i chos can dang*/ g.yo ba dang*/ rab tu 'jig pa dang*/ 'jigs pa nyid dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'tshe ba'i rnam pa dang bdun no/ /de dag gi dang po gnyis mthong lam gyi yid 'byung ba'i dang*/

de 'og gnyis sgom lam gyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i dang*/ de 'og gsum mi slob lam sdug kun 'gog pa'i dmigs pas phye ste rnam grangs bsdu bar gsungs pa'o// 'gog bden la/ nyon mongs 'gog pas bdag med pa dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ spang byas dben pas 'bras bu gya nom dang*/ nges 'byung la phye ba stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa dang*/ mngon par 'du byed med pa ste bdun no// lam bden la/ lam dang*/ rigs pa dang*/ sgrub pa dang*/ nges 'byin dang bzhi'o/ /de ltar rnam pa de rnams mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas ni nyan thos kyi lam 'di shes par byed pa yin zhes bya'o// mdo ni/ byang sems kyi yum gang zhe na 'di la byang sems chen po rnam mkhyen nyid dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas de mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyis gzugs ni mi rtag pa nyid du yid la bya'o/ /zhes sogs so/ /'dis ni lam dang de shes pa'i tshul gnyis ka bstan to// gnyis pa (de'i rgyu sbyor lam bshad pa )ni/ 'phags pa nyan thos lam la ni// gzugs la sogs pa stong pa'i phyir// stong pa nyid rnams dbyer med pas// dro ba de dag mi dmigs pas// rtse mor gyur pa dag tu 'dod// de la rtag la sogs tshul gyis// gnas pa bkag pas bzod pa rnams// sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni// mi gnas rgyas par bstan pa yis// chos kyi mchog tu 'gyur bshad de// ci phyir zhe na sangs rgyas kyis// mkhyen nas chos rnams ma gzigs phyir// bden pa mngon rtogs de yang de nyid dang dmigs rnam cha mthun pa'i sbyor lam las skye bas nyan thos kyis sbyor lam yang rdzogs tshul bstan pa/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi bsgom bya'i lam bden pa bzhi la ni dmigs nas/ gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams stong pa'i phyir stong pa nyid rnams phan tshun dbyer med gcig kho nar sgom pa dro ba'i rnam pa dang*/ chos de dag rang rang gi ngo bo mi dmigs par sgom pa rtse mor gyur pa'i rnam pa dag tu 'dod la/

chos de rnams la rtag pa dang la sogs pas mi rtag pa dang gnyis ka gnyis min gang du yang mi rtog pa'i tshul gyi mtha' la gnas pa bkag pas sgom pa bzod pa'i rnam pa rnams dang*/ mdo las sa bcu dag las brtsams nas ni/ byang phyogs so bdun gyi bar la bden 'dzin dang bcas pas mi gnas par bya ba'i tshul rgyas par bstan pa go ba yis/ kun rdzob pa'i snang ba dang bral bar sgom pa ni chos kyi mchog tu 'gyur ba'i rnam par bshad cing*/ 'o na de'i tshe yul med dgag 'jal byed de blo tshad mar 'gyur ram zhe na/ 'gyur te/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang chos rnams kyi gnas snang mkhyen nas 'khrul rgyus bskyed pa'i chos rnams ma gzigs pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ kau shi ka gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ngo*/ /zhes sogs so// rang rgyal gyi lam shes tshul/ gnyis pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes tshul la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ mtshon bya/ dbye ba/ khyad par ro// dang po (mtshon bya )ni/ smon lam gyi rkyen gyi byang chub rtogs pas rkyen rtogs/ gzhan la ma ltos par sangs rgyas pas rang sangs rgyas zhes so//gnyis pa (dbye ba )ni/ bse ru lta bu/ tshogs spyod che chung gnyis dang gsum ste/ dbang po rno 'bring rtul gsum mo// gsum pa (khyad par )la gnyis te/ lam bgrod tshul/ 'bras bu'o/ /dang po ni/ bse ru lta bu bskal pa brgyar tshogs bsags nas tshogs lam rdzogs pa na/ da dung skye ba len par shes nas phung khams skye mched/ bden pa/ rten 'brel/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa ste/ mkhas par bya ba'i gnas drug la sbyangs te 'chi khar/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing du skye bar gyur cig der yang gzhan la ma ltos par lam bgrod par gyur cig /byang chub thob nas gdul bya la lus kyi rtse bar byed cing ngag gi chos ston par ma gyur cig /ces smon lam btab ste 'chi 'phos nas/

skye ba phyi ma zhing stong par dmangs rigs ma yin pa'i gling gsum gyi skyes pa'i lus rten las dur khrod du yid skyo ba'i rkyen gyis bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems kyis mkhas par bya ba'i gnas rnams sgom pas sbyor mthong sgom mi slob lam rnams tshe de nyid la rdzogs shing*/ mthong spangs nyon sgrib dang gzung rtog spong*/ sgom spangs gzung rtog rnams dang khams gong gi nyon sgrib rnams dgur dril nas spong la/ 'dod nyon mthong lam gyi snga nas spangs pa'o/ /tshogs spyod che chung ni rim pas bskal pa brgya'i sum nyis dang sum cha tsam du tshogs bsags shing*/ tshe de la bzod chen dang mthong lam man thob cing*/ skye ba phyi ma lam lhag ma bgrod nas 'bras bu thob par byed do// gnyis pa ('bras bu )ni/ bse ru lta bu ni sku gcig pur 'dug /gsung mi smra/ thugs bden pa sogs la rtog cing bsod snyoms la spyod pa'i tshe lus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis gdul bya 'dul zhing gcig pur rgyu'o/ /tshogs spyod gnyis de las zla bcas kyi khyad tsam mo/ /rang rgyal gyi grub mtha' ni sems tsam rnam bden pa'o/ /lam gyi rnam gzhag nyan thos ltar yin no// gnyis pa gzhung don la gsum ste/ khyad par 'phags tshul/ lam gyi rang bzhin/ de'i rgyu sbyor lam mo/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ye shes rtogs tshul/ chos ston tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ rang byung bdag nyid rtogs pa'i phyir// gzhan gyis bstan yang mi dgos la// bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni// zab pa nyid du mngon par brjod// nyan thos kyi gang zag las rang rgyal gang zag khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ zad mi skye shes pa'i ye shes rang byung gi bdag nyid du rtogs pa'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan srid pa tha ma'i tshe slob dpon gzhan gyis bstan kyang mi dgos pa la bse ru lta bu'i ye shes ni ches zab pa skad cig de nyid du mngon par rtogs par 'gyur bas so/ /lung las/ nyan thos rnams ni rnam grol sgra phyir 'gro/

/zhes brjod pa'i shugs las gsal lo/ /mdo ni/ chos thams cad kyang sprul pa lta bu yin te/ de la sus kyang bstan pa med do/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (chos ston tshul )ni/ gang gang don ni gang gang la// ji lta ji ltar nyan 'dod pa// de de la don de dang de// sgra med kyang de de ltar snang*// gdul bya gang dang gang dag brjod bya'i don ni gang dang gang dag nyan pa dang rtogs par 'dod pa la ji lta ji ltar nyan 'dod pa bzhin du de dang de la don dang tshig de dang de rnam g.yeng dang bcas pa'i sgras brjod pa med kyang de go zhing rig par 'gyur ba de ltar lus kyi rnam 'gyur snang bar mdzad pa'o/ /mdo ni/ lha'i bu dag bdag la chos nyan pa ni rmi lam gyi skyes bu lta bur 'dod par bya'o/ /zhes so/ /'di dag ni gdul bya'i dbang gis byang sems kyis rang rgyal lta bur bsgyur ba'o// gnyis pa (lam gyi rang bzhin )ni/ gzung don rtog pa spong phyir dang*// 'dzin pa mi spong phyir dang ni// rten gyis bse ru lta bu'i lam// yang dag bsdus par shes par bya// gzung ba phyi don rtog pa spong ba'i phyir dang ste gzung med rtogs pa'o/ /mdo ni/ gzugs ni zab pa ma yin/ zhes so/ rnam par shes pa la bden par 'dzin pa mi spong ba'i phyir dang ni spang ma nus pa'o// mdo ni/ ci yang nyan pa med cing zhes sogs so/ /la la dag /gzung ba med na de 'dzin med/ /ces pa ma yin nam snyam na/ skyon med de/ dper na sgyu ma la bden 'dzin bral kyang de 'dzin pa'i shes pa la bden 'dzin ma bral ba lta bu'o/ /rten gyi khyad par la lam dang rigs gnyis kyi snga ma ni/ yum 'di len par byed pa su dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhes pa'i dri ba'i lan du bstan pa'i mdo don te/ sbyor lam pa mthong lam pa dgra bcom pa tshogs lam pa rnams bstan/ phyi ma ni/ mdo las/ lha rnams kyis mngon par gtor ba'i me tog 'di dag ces dpes bstan te/

sprul pa'i me tog rnams stong pa cig tu mtshungs kyang snang tshul tha dad 'byung ba ltar/ rigs kyang mthar thug gcig tu nges kyang gnas skabs rkyen gyis rang rgyal du gyur pa'o/ /de ltar khyad par gsum po de dag bse ru lta bu'i lam yin cing*/ de yang byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la yang dag par bsdus par shes par bya'o/ /zhes lam dang shes tshul gnyis ka bstan no// gsum pa de'i rgyu sbyor lam yang rdzogs pa'i tshul ni/ btags pa'i chos nyid mi 'gal bar// ston pa'i rnam pa dror gyur pa// rtse mor gyur pa gzugs la sogs// 'grib pa med la sogs pas phye// nang stong nyid la sogs pa yis// gzugs sogs mi 'dzin phyir bzod pa// gzugs sogs skye ba med sogs kyi// rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog/ bden bzhi la dmigs nas sgro btags pa'i kun rdzob rnams don dam pa'i chos nyid dang mi 'gal bar te/ med par ston zhing sgom pa'i rnam pa drod du gyur pa dang rtse mor gyur pa'i rnam pa ni/ gzugs la sogs pa'i yul rnams med pa'i phyir 'grib pa med pa dang la sogs pas 'phel ba med par phye nas sgom pa'o/ /nang stong pa nyid la sogs pa sgom pa'i rnam pas gzugs sogs rang bzhin gyis grub par mi 'dzin pa'i phyir ni bzod pa'o/ /gzugs sogs skye ba med pa dang sogs pas 'gag pa med par sgom pa nyid kyi rnam pa can ni chos kyi mchog go /mdo ni/ kau shi ka gzugs ni btags pa tsam mo/ /gtags pa tsam gang yin pa ni chos nyid de/ zhes sogs so//

byang sems mthong lam/ gsum pa byang sems kyi lam shes tshul la gnyis te/ mthong lam/ sgom lam mo/ dang po (mthong lam )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rten/ mtshan mtshon gzhi gsum/ dang po (rten )ni/ lus rten gling gsum gyi skyes pa bud med 'dod lha gang rung dang sems rten bsam gtan sa drug gang rung ngo*// gnyis pa (mtshan nyid )ni/ bden pa mngon rtogs gang zhig byang chub yan lag gi ngo bor gyur pa'o// gsum pa (mtshon bya )ni/ chos nyid rang rig gi tshul du gsar du mthong zhing myang 'das kyi lam du gyur pa'o/ /so sor na bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du shes pa dang*/ de las rjes su shes pa dang*/ de dang de shes pa la mi skrag pas bzod pa'o// bzhi pa (mtshan gzhi )ni/ rigs pa drug cu par/ chos shes pa yi 'og tu ni// 'di la bye brag yod ma yin// zhes skad cig ma gcig tu bshad la/ de dang mthun par gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/ don dam spros med kyi dbang du byas nas gsungs pa ste/ ji skad du/ de bzhin nyid shes pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa gcig kho na'i sems kyi rang bzhin las brtsams te mthong ba'i lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//zhes so/ /spros bcas kyi ngor yang bsdu ba las chos shes phyogs mthun bzhi/ rjes shes phyogs mthun bzhi/ mjug tu zhi gnas 'ba' zhig pa'i sems gcig ste/ sems rnam pa dgus mthong ba'i lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ zhes so// kun btus su ni/ yul dang yul can gnyis/ snga ma la de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i ye shes gnyis/ phyi ma'ang de gnyis kyi yul can gnyis/ de'i dang po la chos bzod bzhi/ chos shes bzhi/ gnyis pa la rjes bzod bzhi/ rjes shes bzhi ste sems kyi skad cig bcu drug tu gsungs so/ /'di dang rgyan rtsa 'grel gyi dgongs pa mthun cing*/ de ni chos nyid mngon du gyur pa'i mnyam bzhag thun cig la dbye ba med kyang chos can so so dang 'brel ba'i nges pa 'dren tshul las phye ba'o//

gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ /dang po ni/ bden dang bden la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig rnam bzhi yis// lam shes nyid la mthong ba'i lam// phan yon bcas pa 'di bshad do// sdug kun gyi bden pa dang 'gog lam gyi bden pa la so sor chos shes pa'i bzod pa dang*/ chos shes pa dang rjes su shes pa'i bzod pa dang rjes su shes pa ste skad cig rnam pa bzhi bzhir mngon par rtogs pa yis ni lam shes nyid kyi skabs las byang sems kyi mthong ba'i lam 'di phyi'i phan yon dang bcas pa 'di bshad do/ /mdo ni/ rab 'byor gyi le'u las btsal bar bya'o//zhes so// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas dag/ phan tshun brten pa rten med phyir// rnam grangs khas mi len pa dang*// chen po tshad ma med bcas dang*// tshad med pa dang mtha' med dang*// der gnas gzugs la sogs pa la// sangs rgyas nyid du nges 'dzin dang*// blang med dor ba med sogs dang*// byams la sogs dang stong nyid dang*// sangs rgyas nyid ni 'thob pa dang*// rnam par byang kun yongs bsdus dang*// nyam nga ba dang nad kun sel// mya ngan 'das 'dzin zhi nyid dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis srung la sogs// srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// bdag nyid gnas te sems can dag/ 'god dang sbyin pa la sogs pa// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba// lam shes nyid kyi skad cig ma// nges pa 'dren tshul sgro 'dogs sel byed kyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ rgyu dus kyi de bzhin nyid dang 'bras dus kyi sangs rgyas dag rang ngo dbyer mi rung bas phan tshun dang*/ brten pa dang rten gyi tshul du med pa'i phyir ming gi rnam grangs su yang khas mi len pa ste ma yin par rtogs pa dang*/ yul chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs rtogs pa'i ye shes chen po dang*/ kun brtags rnam brtags kyi gzugs sogs 'phags pa'i tshad mas gzigs pa med pa ste mi lta ba dang bcas pa dang*/

/chos nyid kyi gzugs sogs sems can gyi yul min pas dpag tu med par rtogs pa dang bzhi ni sdug bsngal chos bzod sogs so/ /mdo ni/ gzugs kyi de bzhin nyid la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa mi dmigs zhes sogs so// chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med par rtogs pa dang*/ der gnas mnyam gzhag gi yul du gyur pa'i don dam gyi gzugs la sogs pa la sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'dzin pa dang*/ chos thams cad la blang bya med cing dor ba med pa dang sogs pas bar chad kyi glags mi rnyed pa'i tshul gyi sgom pa dang*/ mi dmigs pa'i byams pa la sogs pa'i tshad med bzhi rtogs pa dang bzhi kun 'byung la chos bzod sogs so/ /gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang sems kyi phar phyin 'di ni mtha' yas so/ /zhes so// mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi stong nyid sgom pa'i ye shes dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag par byed cing sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par rtogs pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par byang ba kun yongs su bsdus pa'i sgo nas dang*/ mi mthun phyogs la nyam nga ba dang nad gdon kun sel ba'i ye shes dang bzhi ni 'gog pa la chos bzod sogs so/ /nang stong pa nyid mi dmigs pa'i tshul gyi shin tu sgom pa'i phyir/ zhes so// mya ngan las 'das par 'dod pa'i 'dzin pa zhi zhing med pa'i ye shes nyid dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsrung ba dang la sogs pas skyob pa dang sba bar mdzad pa'i ye shes dang*/ srog mi gcod pa la sogs pa dge bcu sngon du 'gro bas rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni bdag nyid gnas te/ sems can gzhan dag kyang de la 'god pa'i ye shes dang*/ sbyin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba spyad pa'i 'bras bu sems can thams cad dang thun mong du rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba'i ye shes dang bzhi ni lam la chos bzod sogs so//mya ngan las 'das pa 'dzin pa nye bar zhi bar byed de rnam par 'phel bar byed pa ma yin no/

/zhes so// de rnams ni byang sems kyi lam shes nyid las mthong lam gyi skad cig ma bcu drug go 'di dag gis mthong lam gyi dbye ba tsam du ma zad rnam pa dag kyang bstan pa yin te/ mngon par rtogs pa'i rim pa bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ sgom lam/ gnyis pa sgom lam la gnyis te/ sgom lam gyi byed pa/ byed pa can gyi sgom lam mo/ /dang po ni/ kun nas zhi dang thams cad la// 'dud dang nyon mongs las rgyal dang*// gnod pas brdzi ba med nyid dang*// byang chub dang ni rten mchod nyid// lam la brod pa skye ba'i phyir theg chen sgom lam gyi phan yon bshad pa/ 'khor gsum du rtog pa kun nas zhi ba dang nga rgyal med pas skye bo thams cad la 'dud pa dang nyon mongs las rgyal bas sems 'khrug pa mi 'byung ba dang pha rol gyi gnod pas brdzi ba med pa nyid dang*/ myur du byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob pa nyid dang ni byang sems de gang du bzhugs shing bsten pa'i gnas sogs kyang 'gro bas mchod pa'i yul nyid du 'gyur ba dang drug go /mdo ni/ yum ni de ltar byang sems chen po rnams 'dul ba dang zhes sogs so// gnyis pa byed pa can gyi sgom lam la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rten/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba'o// dang po ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam sngar med gsar skye'i lus rten ni mthong lam gang la skyes pa'i rten no/ /gnas pa ni/ nyan thos ltar na khams gsum ga rang rgyal ltar na 'dod rten/ byang sems ltar na 'dod gzugs kyi rten can no/ /byang sems gzugs med nyer 'gro sogs ni/ sprul pas 'gro ba'am skye ba'i nus pa yod pa tsam la dgongs so/ /sems rten ni mngon pa ltar na zag med sa dgu gang rung la brten/ 'dir ni byang sems thabs la mkhas pas nyon mongs pa'i sa bon ma spangs kyang nyon mongs kyis gnod par mi 'gyur bas 'dod pa dang srid rtse la yang brten par bshad pa'o//

gnyis pa (mtshan nyid )ni/ mngon rtogs gong nas gong du bskyed cing sgom pa 'phags lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'o// gsum pa (dbye ba )ni/ spyir na 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom lam gnyis/ bye brag tu phyi ma de las 'dir byang sems kyi sgom lam la zag bcas zag med gnyis/ 'di'i zag pa ni gzung 'dzin gnyis snang can yang dag min rtog go /des na mnyam bzhag gi tshe rtog pa de mngon gyur du mi 'byung bas zag med dang rjes thob kyi tshe de snang ba dang bcas nas ye shes dang mnyam du 'jug pas zag bcas sgom lam du 'gyur la/ de yang gnyis snang gi cha nas lam min yang 'dzin cha sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas bzhag pa'o/ /'di ni snang med pa dang mi mtshungs te 'dir mnyam bzhag gi sbyor bar zhugs pa na/ gnyis snang sna tshogs dpyad gzhir gzung zhing snang med pas gnyis med kyi shes pa dpyad gzhir bzung ba'i khyad dang don dam rnam pa thams cad pa'i snang ba yod med kyi khyad yod pas so// zag bcas sgom lam/ gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ zag bcas sgom lam/ zag med sgom lam mo/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dge ba gsog byed mos pa/ chud mi za bar byed pa bsngo ba/ spel bar byed pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam mo/ /dang po (dge ba gsog byed mos pa )la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ mos pa rang gi don dang ni// rang gzhan don dang gzhan don dang*// rnam gsum shes bya de yang ni// chung dang 'bring dang chen po ste// so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// de yang rnam gsum de ltar na// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod// sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su yid ches pa'i dad pa ni mos pa sgom lam ste/ ma dag sa bdun du ni yum rang gi don ngo bo nyid sku'i 'byung gnas su mos shing gzhan gyi ched du rang don sgrub pa dang ni/ sa brgyad dgu gnyis su yum rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don chos sku'i 'byung gnas su mos shing rang gzhan gyi don gnyis mnyam du sgrub pa dang*/

sa bcu par yum gzhan don gzugs sku'i 'byung gnas su mos shing gzhan don 'ba' zhig bsgrubs pas rang don zhar la 'grub pa dang*/ rtsa ba'i dbye ba rnam pa gsum du shes par bya la de las phye ba/ de yang ni/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po dang*// so sor rnam pa gsum du 'dod// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// de yang rnam gsum de ltar na// rnam pa nyi shu bdun du 'dod// mdo ni/ yum zab mo ni bris shing glegs bam du bgyid de zhes sogs so// gnyis pa phan yon ni/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa la// mos pa'i gnas skabs rnams la ni// dgu tshan gsum gyis bstod pa dang*// bkur ba dang ni bsngags par 'dod// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mos pa'i gnas skabs kyi byang sems de rnams la ni rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis spro ba bskyed par mdzad de/ 'di ltar rang don gnyis don gzhan don dgu tshan gsum gyi gnas skabs kyi tshe/ so sor dang po la bstod pa dang*/ gnyis pa la bkur ba dang ni gsum pa la bsngags par mdzad par 'dod do/ /mdo ni/ gaṅgā'i bye snyed de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis bkang ba gang yin pa dang*/ yum gyi cha gnyis las gang rung 'dam du stsal na 'di nyid len zhes so// gnyis pa dge ba chud mi za bar byed pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam la gsum ste/ sgra bshad/ spyi'i rnam gzhag gzhung dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ pa ri ṇā ya ka zhes pa yongs su bsgyur ba ste dge ba thams cad rdzogs byang du bsgyur ba'i don no// gnyis pa (spyi'i rnam gzhag )ni/ smon lam ni dge rtsa mtshon byed du ma bzung bar spyi tsam nas mos pa la bzhag bsngo ba ni/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi dge ba gang rung zhig mtshon byar byas nas de sems can kun gyi don du rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'o/ /chos nyid 'dus ma byas la rang bzhin 'gyur ba med kyang de'i dri ma nyams smad pas rang ngo rim gyis gsal bar 'gyur ba tsam yin la/

de rang ldog nas bsngo rgyu min yang mos pa'i rlom tshod du bsngos pas 'dus byas kyi dge ba bsngos pa las lhag pa'o// gsum pa (gzhung dang sbyar ba )ni/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can// de yi byed pa mchog yin no// de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// dben dang sangs rgyas bsod nams tshogs// rang bzhin dran pa'i spyod yul can// thabs bcas mtshan ma med pa dang*// sangs rgyas rjes su yi rang dang*// khams gsum gtogs pa ma yin dang*// chung dang 'bring dang chen po yi// bsngo ba gzhan ni rnam gsum po// bsod nams che 'byung bdag nyid do// sems can rnams kyi don du dge ba rdzogs byang du mi dmigs par yongs su bsngo ba ni de'i byed pa 'bras bu mchog thob par byed pa yin no zhes ngo bo ngos bzung ba'o/ /mdo ni/ yongs su bsngo ba 'di nyid rab ces bya'o/ /zhes so// de la ldog pas phye na bcu gnyis las dang po/ /dman pa'i byang chub las khyad par can du byed pa rdzogs byang du mi dmigs par bsngo ba/ bsngo ba zhes 'og ma rnams la sbyar ro// gnyis pa bsngo bya'i rdzas de ni dmigs med kyi rnam pa can du/ gsum pa sems kyi 'du shes phyin ci ma log pa'i mtshan nyid du/ bzhi pa byed po rang la gang zag dang chos su 'dzin pas dben par dang*/ lnga pa dge ba rang bzhin stong nyid du nges pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rnams kyang rang bzhin dmigs med 'dus ma byas las byung bar dran pa'i spyod yul can gyi/ drug pa phyin drug la bzang ngan mi lta bar thabs de dag thams cad dang bcas par dang*/ bdun pa dngos med kho nar 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma med par dang*/ brgyad pa gang du'ang mi 'dzin par sangs rgyas kyi bsngo bar mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang ba ste tshul de ltar dang*/ dgu pa khams gsum du gtogs pa ste gnas pa ma yin pa dang*/ bcu pa bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa gsum ni/

chung ngu dang 'bring dang chen po'i bsngo ba snga ma rnams las gzhan du bstan pa ni rnam pa gsum po ste/ rim pas sems can thams cad dge ba bcu nas mngon shes lnga ldan gyi bar du bkod pa dang*/ de rnams rgyun zhugs nas dgra bcom gyi bar du gyur pa la mchod pa dang*/ de rnams sangs rgyas su gyur pa la dmigs bcas kyi mchod pa'i dge ba las/ byang sems kyis de gsum la rjes su yi rang zhing de'i dge ba mi dmigs pas bsngo ba gsum po de bsod nams chen po 'byung ba ste lhag pa'i bdag nyid do// mdo ni/ nyan rang thams cad kyi sbyin sogs bsod nams bya ba'i dngos po las byang sems kyi bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba 'di rab ces bya'o/ /zhes sogs so// gsum pa dge ba spel bar byed pa rjes su yi rang sgom lam ni/ thabs dang mi dmigs pa dag gis// dge ba'i rtsa la yid rang ba// rjes su yid rang yid byed pa// sgom pa yin par 'dir brjod do// gzhan gyi thabs bsod nams kyi tshogs dang de dag mi dmigs pa ye shes kyi tshogs dag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bsgrubs pa la yi rang ba ste/ dga' ba'i sems kyis rjes su yi rang ba yid la byed pa yang zag bcas sgom pa'i lam yin par 'dir brjod do/ /mdo ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis rjes su yi rang ba dang ldan pa'i zhes sogs so//

zag med sgom lam/ gnyis pa zag med sgom lam la gnyis te/ bar chad med lam gyi ngo bo sgrub pa sgom lam/ rnam grol lam gyi ngo bo rnam dag sgom lam mo/ /dang po ni/ de yi ngo bo nyid mchog nyid// kun la mngon par 'du mi byed// chos rnams dmigs su med par ni// gtod par byed pa don chen nyid// yum gyi yon tan nam rang bzhin gsal bar sgrub pa'i phyir mnyam par 'jog pa sa gnyis pa'i bar chad med lam ste/ de yi ngo bo ni 'od gsal ba'i ye shes nyid dang*/ 'di ni lam rnams kyi mchog nyid dang*/ sgom tshul ni gzugs sogs kun la mtshan mas mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang*/ kun rdzob pa'i chos rnams dmigs su med par ni sbyor ba'i dus nas rnam pa gtod par byed cing*/ dngos gzhi'i dus su de la zhugs pa dang*/ 'bras bu ni don chen po chos sku nyid sgrub par byed pa'o/ /mdo ni/ shā ri'i bus gsol ba/ yum 'di ni snang bar bgyid pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (rnam grol lam gyi ngo bo rnam dag sgom lam )la gnyis te/ rnam dag thob pa'i rgyur spang blang ngos bzung ba/ 'bras bu rnam dag dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas bsten dang sbyin sogs dang*// thabs la mkhas pa gang yin pa// 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin// chos kyis 'phongs pa'i rgyu dag ni// bdud kyi thibs kyis non pa dang*// zab mo'i chos la ma mos dang*// phung po la sogs mngon zhen dang*// sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs zin pa'o// sher phyin rtogs pa'i rgyu gang zhe na sangs rgyas mang po bsten pa dang*/ bskal pa dpag med nas sbyin sogs phar phyin la zhugs pa dang thabs la mkhas pas de dag mi dmigs shing dbang po'i rim pa dang 'tsham par lung ston pa sogs gang yin pa rnams ni byang sems dbang rnon sher phyin 'di la mos pa'i rgyu dag yin la de rnam dag skye ba'i rgyu'o/ /mdo ni/ sangs rgyas grangs med bsnyen bkur byas nas 'dir 'ongs/

zhes so// yum gyi chos kyis 'phongs pa ste spong ba'i rgyu dag ni/ bdud kyi byin rlabs kyis thibs kyis non pa dang zab mo'i chos la ma mos pa dang phung po la sogs pa'i kun rdzob la mngon par zhen pa dang sdig pa'i grogs pos yongs su zin pa'o/ /rnam pa bzhi po de dag dang ldan na skyes bu glen pa zhes so// gnyis pa ('bras bu rnam dag dngos )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la/ nges don du bzhag na/ dri ma kun rdzob pa ye nas med pa'i phyir shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos dbyings bde gshegs snying po gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs blos gzhag tu med pa de la rnam dag ces bya'o// drang don ltar bzhag na/ 'bum ṭīka tu/ gzugs sogs ni dag par bya ba'o/ /yum ni dag par byed pa'o/ /'bras bu ni rgyun zhugs la sogs pa'i 'bras bu'o/ /gnyis su med pa ni ngo bo'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'bras bu rnam grol dag pa spang bya dag pa la stos/ spang bya dag pa rnam grol gyi rang rgyu bar chad med lam la ltos pa'o// gnyis pa gzhung don la bzhi ste/ rnam dag spyir bstan/ so sor bshad pa/ shin tu ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan/ de la klan ka spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'bras bu dag pa gzugs la sogs// dag pa nyid de gang gi phyir// de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing*// gcad du med pas dag par brjod// 'bras bu chos dbyings rang ngo spros pa ma yin pa'i dag pa dang*/ glo bur dri ma gzugs la sogs pa gzod nas med pa'i dag pa gnyis gcig pa nyid yin te/ gang gi phyir na dag pa de gnyis tha dad ma yin zhing*/ de nyid dang gzhan du dpyad du med pa'i phyir te/ thams cad kyang dag par ro gcig tu brjod do/ /mdo ni/ gzugs rnam par dag pa dang 'bras bu rnam par dag pa dang yum rnam par dag pa 'di la gnyis su med cing*/ zhes so// gnyis pa (so sor bshad pa )ni/ nyon mongs shes bya lam gsum gyi//

nyams phyir slob ma bse ru dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyi dag pa ste// sangs rgyas rnam kun shin tu ba// nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang de'i steng du shes bya'i dri ma gzung rtog dang bcas pa dang*/ de'i steng du 'dzin rtog dang bcas pa ste/ lam gsum char gyi dri ma nyams pa'i sgo nas bzhag pa'i phyir/ slob ma nyan thos dang*/ bse ru rang sangs rgyas dang*/ rgyal sras rnams kyi mngon rtogs gsum la dag pa zhes bya ste/ de las kyang sangs rgyas kyi rnam kun mkhyen pa'i ye shes la rnam dag shin tu ba zhes bya ste sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa bral bas so//mdo ni/ bdag rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni gzugs rnam par dag pa'o/ /zhes sogs so// gsum pa (shin tu ba yin pa'i rgyu mtshan )ni/ sa dgu la ni chen po yi// chen po la sogs dri ma yi// gnyen po chung ngu'i chung ngu la// sogs pa'i lam ni dag pa yin// sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kho na la rnam dag shin tu bar brjod de/ 'dod pa sogs sa dgu la ni theg gsum gyi sgom spangs gang yin pa chen po'i chen po la sogs pa'i dri ma'i cha rnams/ gnyen po rang rang gi sgom lam mnyam bzhag ye shes chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa'i lam gyis ni dag par byas pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug yin pa'i phyir/ mdo ni/ gzugs rnam par dag pa gang yin pa de ni rnam mkhyen nyid kyi bar du rnam par dag pa ste/ zhes so// bzhi pa (de la klan ka spang ba )ni/ de la klan ka spangs pa yis// lam ni 'jal dang gzhal bya dag/ mnyam pa nyid kyis khams gsum gyi// gnyen po nyid du 'dod pa yin// spang bya chung ngu la gnyen po chen po bskyed pa dang khams gcig na yod pa'i gnyen pos khams gsum char gyi sgrib pa sel ba mi rigs so zhes de la klan ka 'tshol na/ skyon med de/ dri ma phra mo 'khrud pa la 'bad pa cher bskyed dgos pa ltar spang bya spangs pa'i phyir dang*/ khams gcig na yod pa'i lam shes ni 'jal byed dang*/

kun khyab gzhal bya'i yul chos dbyings dag gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du 'gyur ba nyid kyis phyir/ spang bya khams gsum gyi gnyen po gcig nyid du 'dod pa yin no/ /'dir go bar bya ba/ spang gnyen mngon gyur gnyis lhan gcig mi 'byung ste/ yid shes rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis cig car mi 'byung bas so/ /des na bar chad med lam skyes tsam nas spang bya mngon gyur zhi nas kun gzhi'i steng du sa bon tsam gnas pa de spong ba yin no/ /mdo ni/ rnam par dag pa ni 'dod pa'i khams su skye ba ma lags/ zhes so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs gnyis pa'o// // shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs gnyis pa'i 'grel pa'o// //
